name: website-gap-finder
title: Website Gap Finder: Local Business Leads + Website Audit
description: Find local business leads for web agencies and freelancers with a website audit of every business in a Google Maps scraper dataset or your own list. Flags no website, broken or outdated sites, no HTTPS, no mobile layout and no online booking, then scores each lead 0-100 with a ready pitch line. Works in any country.
